title: A Extraction for the Border
author: Beatrix Oyelaran
blurb: Ivo Pemberton, a hostage negotiator with one failure still on the board, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. But when the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must burn the network that did the training before the markets open in Frankfurt.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
